title: Capsule rain system

reference.grammar: one field of rounded capsules in columns, growing along an axis with five inks in sequence; used full, sparse, clipped to shapes and inside hairline frames; tracked mono labels; gray sheet

techniques.name: Capsule columns

gap.note: gap as a share of the pill length

fill.note: chance that a slot holds a pill

fall.note: phase of the fall; Motion runs it

techniques.limits: Pitch under the largest width (10.5 u) makes columns overlap their neighbors; that is intended at 6.5 u and turns to a solid tint under ~4 u. gap under ~0.1 fuses a column into a bar.
techniques.implementation: Each column is filled top to bottom with rounded bars whose length and width are set by the column’s position t on the growth axis; lengths vary ±50 %.

techniques.name: Wedge envelope

floor.note: filled share of the height at t = 0

scatter.note: chance of a pill above the wedge, falling with distance

techniques.limits: floor at 1 fills the frame and the wedge is gone. scatter above ~0.4 hides the wedge edge.
techniques.implementation: The filled height is floor + (1 − floor)·t^power from the anchor side; a few pills are allowed past the edge.

techniques.name: Ink bands on the axis

offset.note: slides the bands along the axis

width.note: gaussian width of each band in t

techniques.limits: width above ~0.35 mixes all five inks everywhere. Under ~0.05 the inks meet in hard stripes.
techniques.implementation: Each pill draws its ink from five gaussian bands along t and is composited with multiply, so overlaps print darker.

techniques.name: Shape clip

params.shapes: frame rectangle · ring with a gap

techniques.limits: An inner radius within ~20 u of the outer leaves a band thinner than one long capsule and the field no longer reads.
techniques.implementation: The capsule field is drawn through a clip path: a rectangle for framed panels, a ring with an opening for the mark.

techniques.name: Hairline frame
techniques.limits: Above ~3 u the frame competes with the capsules.
techniques.implementation: A square-cornered rectangle stroked once over the clipped field.

techniques.name: Tracked mono label
techniques.limits: Tracking above ~0.4 em breaks words into letters at this size.
techniques.implementation: Capitals in JetBrains Mono, set letter by letter with 0.22 em added; a short rule sits one gap below the last line.

techniques.name: Sheet grain
techniques.limits: Above ~0.06 the grain shows inside the flat inks.
techniques.implementation: A mono multiply grain over the finished sheet.

pass_order: fields · capsule columns per panel, clipped, multiplied
labels · tracked mono capitals and rules
notes: Measured on ref.png: column pitch ≈ 7 px at 1080 px (6.5 u); longest capsule ≈ 84 px; frame rule ≈ 1.3 px; label cap height ≈ 9 px.
Words are invented and plain. The subject is new: panel sizes, the ring and the order of panels differ from the reference.
